entries.title: Panels on your iPhone or iPad no longer slow its catch-up
entries.body: When your iPhone or iPad comes back after being away, each panel it runs now hears everything it missed at once, once the catch-up is read, instead of one update at a time, so the panels no longer add to the wait. The phone also tells the computer where your first mate lives how long its catch-up took, which that computer keeps in its own log.
entries.noPicture: This changes how long a catch-up takes, not how any view looks.
entries.noDocsSite: No docs site page describes how the phone catches up or the computer's catch-up log.
